title: De novo design of a protein fold for small-molecule binding through aromatic π stacking
authors: Stephanie T. Ouchida; Maggie Horst; Xuxu Gou; Ian Bakanas; A. Katherine Hatstat; Lee Schnaider; Morgan E. Diolaiti; Alan Ashworth; Willliam F. DeGrado
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算设计生成全新蛋白折叠以结合小分子阿霉素，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与AI设计方法，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: The de novo design of proteins that bind chemically complex small molecules has broad chemical and biological implications, but strategies typically rely on a small set of protein scaffolds and require extensive experimental screening. Here, we computationally designed proteins around a minimal aromatic π-stacking motif to bind the anthracycline anticancer drug doxorubicin. Experimental characterization of twelve proteins revealed a µM doxorubicin binder; two additional design cycles improved scaffold stability and binding affinity to yield an 85-residue protein that binds doxorubicin with a dissociation constant of 85 nM. An X-ray crystal structure of the protein-drug complex confirmed the accuracy of the designed π-π stacking interactions. The designed protein could act to protect cultured cells from doxorubicin-induced cytotoxicity. Unlike previous ligand-binding protein designs based on repeat proteins or naturally occurring folds, the designed protein adopts a previously unobserved 5-helix globular fold, indicating that a broader space of folded, functional proteins exists even for compact tertiary structures smaller than 100 residues. These results demonstrate that motif-guided generative protein design can discover compact de novo protein folds capable of high-affinity recognition of chemically complex small molecules.
abstract_zh: 化学复杂小分子的蛋白质从头设计具有广泛的化学和生物学意义，但现有策略通常依赖于少数蛋白质支架，并需要大量的实验筛选。在此，我们通过计算设计，围绕一个最小的芳香π-堆积基序，构建了能够结合蒽环类抗癌药物阿霉素的蛋白质。对十二种蛋白质的实验表征揭示了一种µM级别的阿霉素结合蛋白；随后两轮设计循环改善了支架稳定性和结合亲和力，最终获得一个85残基的蛋白质，其与阿霉素的解离常数为85 nM。蛋白质-药物复合物的X射线晶体结构证实了所设计的π-π堆积相互作用的准确性。该设计蛋白能够保护培养细胞免受阿霉素诱导的细胞毒性。与以往基于重复蛋白或天然折叠的配体结合蛋白设计不同，该设计蛋白采用了一种此前未观察到的5螺旋球状折叠，表明即使在小于100残基的紧凑三级结构中，也存在更广阔的折叠功能性蛋白质空间。这些结果证明，基序引导的生成式蛋白质设计能够发现紧凑的从头蛋白质折叠，并实现对化学复杂小分子的高亲和力识别。
